title: U.S. Restores Some Vaccine and Health Aid to Unicef, Gavi and World Food Programme
summary_full: The amount is still far below what the U.S. spent previously on humanitarian and health aid, but resumes the flow of money for key efforts to fight malnutrition and disease.
